title: Leaving high school: Potsdam, Ithaca and joining Jimmy Cavallo
summary: Poor grades keep him out of Potsdam; he skips Ithaca College when Jimmy Cavallo's band calls three days after graduation.

bands.name: Jimmy Cavallo and the House Rockers

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: No. I went on the road. Well I’ll explain that one okay. I graduate from high school. I was accepted — I wanted to get to Potsdam because Prof’s family was up there. But once again the physical attraction I had to the female I was going with in high school probably cost me commendable grades. So I got a letter from Prof Stanley that said, he said, “you are head and shoulders above any of the drummers up here but we can’t let you in

because your grades are not high enough.” I got out of high school with band, orchestra, chorus and theory. I mean I just barely got out. I couldn’t wait to get out anyway. Then I got accepted to Ithaca College, because I had studied with Warren Benson back when I was at St. Mary’s, with no band director there. And I had paid my $200 initiation fee and I had a jam session with a bass player, now deceased, named Tony Leonardi, and Frank Pezzullo and a whole bunch of guys from the Syracuse area. And he was with Jimmy Cavallo’s band. I don’t know if you ever heard of him. He made a movie called “Rock Rock Rock” or, I don’t know. Jimmy Cavallo and the House Rockers. We called it Jimmy Cavallo and the House Wreckers. But the phone call came in, “come out here to New Bedford and join the band.” This was like I graduated on a Thursday and I’m on the road on Sunday. And I did that for the entire summer and didn’t go to Ithaca College. Tony said, “there’s no real reason to go over there.” And I didn’t. So I lost the initiation fee, which $200 in 1963 was $200. I mean it’s probably about a thousand dollars now, I don’t know. So I went on the road for the summer with that.
Yeah. What was that called? “Rock Rock Rock” or something?
No, but I know the band you’re talking about. This was a very hyped up shuffle —
Yeah there was a lot of different people — Connie Francis was in that movie. I mean that was a movie. I mean they made a movie. I wasn’t — it was before I was with the band.
